recommendations (recent)","hideWhenNoData":true},"glossary_md":{"type":"splunk.markdown","options":{"backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)","markdown":"### About these metrics
- **Readiness** — Oura's daily 0–100 estimate of how recovered/ready you are. **↑ higher is better**. Built from the contributors below.
- **Readiness contributors** — body temperature, HRV balance, resting HR, recovery index (0–100-ish sub-scores). **↑ higher is better** for each.
- **Resilience** — longer-term capacity to handle stress: limited → adequate → solid → strong → exceptional. **higher tier is better**.
- **Vascular (cardiovascular) age** — Oura's estimate of your arterial age from overnight pulse-wave data. **↓ lower is better**.
- **Pulse-wave velocity (PWV)** — the raw speed of the pressure wave through your arteries (m/s) that Vascular Age is derived from. **↓ lower is better** — stiffer arteries push it up.
- **SpO2** — blood-oxygen saturation overnight. **↑ higher is better** — ~95–100% is typical.
- **Respiration** — average breaths per minute during sleep. **Context** — a stable, low sleeping rate is a good sign; a jump can accompany illness or stress.
- **Breathing disturbance index** — Oura's count of breathing interruptions overnight (a sleep-apnea-adjacent signal). **↓ lower is better** — the trend matters more than any single night.
- **Sleep-time recommendation** — Oura's suggested bedtime window and whether you followed it. **'optimal'/'good' is better** than 'pay attention'.

_Oura-specific scores. Requires an Oura ring (Cardiovascular Age + Resilience may need extra API token scopes)._

**Learn more:** [Oura — Readiness](https://support.ouraring.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025589793-Readiness-Score)"}}},"layout":{"type":"absolute","options":{"width":1440,"height":2330,"display":"auto"},"structure":[{"item":"intro_md","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":20,"w":1400,"h":120}},{"item":"readiness_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":160,"w":226,"h":150}},{"item":"resilience_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":256,"y":160,"w":226,"h":150}},{"item":"vascage_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":492,"y":160,"w":226,"h":150}},{"item":"spo2_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":728,"y":160,"w":226,"h":150}},{"item":"resp_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":964,"y":160,"w":226,"h":150}},{"item":"pwv_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":1200,"y":160,"w":220,"h":150}},{"item":"readiness_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":330,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"readiness_contrib","type":"block","position":{"x":730,"y":330,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"resilience_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":650,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"vascage_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":730,"y":650,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"spo2_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":970,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"resp_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":730,"y":970,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"pwv_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":1290,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"bdi_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":730,"y":1290,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"sleeptime","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":1610,"w":1400,"h":280}},{"item":"glossary_md","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":1910,"w":1400,"h":400}}],"globalInputs":["input_global_trp","input_person"]}}
